progression.prerequisiteKnowledge: B1: gametes (sperm, egg) join in sexual reproduction, copies without joining are asexual, a clone and the conditions favouring clones or variety. B2a: fertilisation and zygote. Roots take up water and leaves make food in light.
progression.startsWith: A gardener with one strawberry plant, a runner, a flower and a bee brushing off pollen.
progression.stopsAfter: Sequencing pollination to seed with the pollen tube explained, separating pollination from fertilisation, naming vegetative propagation as the asexual plant route, and matching each to conditions in a short answer.
progression.nextLesson: B2c: reproduction without flowers or seeds: yeast, bacteria and protists.

teaching.task: Outline how a flowering plant makes a seed from pollination to seed formation, and say when seeds suit better than vegetative propagation.
teaching.causalExplanation: The sperm-forming cells are in the pollen and the egg is deep in the ovary, and plant sperm cannot swim, so pollination only delivers pollen; the pollen tube grows down the style, guided by chemical signals, carrying sperm to the egg, where fertilisation makes a zygote that becomes an embryo; the ovule becomes a seed and the ovary a fruit. Vegetative propagation makes clones without sperm or egg, so runners are fast and alike while seeds are varied and travel.
teaching.conversationalApproach: Opens with a bee brushing pollen onto a strawberry flower and asks whether a seed exists yet, builds the journey with a persistent name key and a land, tube, join, seed strip, then builds an outline answer on screen one sentence at a time.
teaching.openingDecision: A bee brushes pollen onto a flower. Has the plant made a seed yet, and what has to happen before it does?
teaching.understandingCheck: Say which step failed when bagged flowers make no seed, whether fertilisation has happened when tubes are part-way down the style, and why a potato field grown from tubers is at more risk from a new disease.
teaching.curriculumScope: Describe the mechanisms of reproduction in flowering plants and vegetative propagation (BIO12-12, Module 5). Meiosis, haploid and diploid, self- and cross-pollination, double fertilisation, and fungi, bacteria and protists (B2c) are deferred.

design.visualSystem: Explainer engine: warm paper stage, handwritten Caveat headings, amber doodle layer, painted flower and plant plates with a coded pollen tube path, sperm dots, a persistent name key, a land, tube, join, seed strip and answer cards.
design.transitionPlan: Push-through from the runner to the flower; the camera pushes into the stamens then travels down the carpel; the bee flies between flowers; the camera follows the growing tube; crossfade from ovary to pod and from seed to seedling; plates change one plant at a time; the board splits for the conditions comparison; scene crossfade with settle.

scenes.visualReference: Strawberry runner and flower plates (alpha) with the bee plate and coded pollen specks
scenes.teachingReason: Poses the question of whether pollen arriving means a seed has formed, and names the two plant routes
scenes.narrationCue: runner / Or it can flower / bee landing / Has the plant made a seed yet
scenes.motionPurpose: The runner stem draws on, the board pushes through to the flower, a bee flies in and shakes off pollen, then a question mark and empty seed outline hold still
scenes.onScreenChange: The connecting stem draws on at "runner"; push-through to the flower plate on "Or it can flower"; the bee flies in and yellow pollen specks fall on the centre; a question mark and empty "seed?" outline appear and hold about two seconds before "Not yet"; the heading writes on

scenes.visualReference: Flower cut-away plate with coded pollen grain and stacked name key
scenes.teachingReason: Shows where the sperm-forming cells are made and introduces the part names one at a time
scenes.narrationCue: stamens / anthers / pollen grain / up here
scenes.motionPurpose: The camera pushes into the stamens, names draw on and drop into the name key, and a pollen grain pops out of an anther
scenes.onScreenChange: The cut-away appears with "typical flower"; the camera pushes in on "stamens"; a scribble circle on "anthers" and a plain-cell pollen grain pops out; each name draws on with a leader line and drops into the stacked key; the STAMEN has MEN tag writes on; a pin lands on the anthers on "up here"

scenes.visualReference: Same flower cut-away with ovule close-up crossfade and persistent name key
scenes.teachingReason: Shows where the egg sits and sets the distance problem the pollen tube solves
scenes.narrationCue: stigma / style / ovary / egg cell / buried deep / can't swim
scenes.motionPurpose: The camera travels down the carpel, names drop into the key, the ovule close-up shows the egg, and a dotted measure line links the two pins
scenes.onScreenChange: The camera follows the carpel on "stigma", "style", "ovary"; names draw on and join the key; the ovule close-up crossfades in with the egg dot lit on "egg cell"; a second pin lands on "buried deep"; a dotted red measure line and a crossed-out swimming sperm appear on "can't swim"

scenes.visualReference: Bee flight between two flower plates, grass and wind plate, water icon, then the cut-away with the name key
scenes.teachingReason: Defines pollination and shows it only delivers pollen, so it is not fertilisation
scenes.narrationCue: pollination / rubs off / wind / not fertilisation
scenes.motionPurpose: The bee flies flower to flower and pollen drops on the stigma, carrier icons gain a carries-pollen tag, then a bracket shows pollen and egg still far apart
scenes.onScreenChange: The bee flies along a motion path with pollen specks and a few drop on the stigma on "rubs off"; a pollen cloud drifts from the grass plate on "wind" and a ripple icon appears for water; each carrier gets an amber "carries pollen" tag; back at the cut-away a bracket reads "still far apart" and a tick on arrival and cross on "= seed" appear on "not fertilisation"

scenes.visualReference: Cut-away with coded pollen tube path, chemical signal dots, sperm dots and pollen grain close-up
scenes.teachingReason: Explains how the tube solves the distance problem and carries sperm to the egg
scenes.narrationCue: takes in water / grows a thin tube / guided by chemical signals / the two sperm cells form / small opening
scenes.motionPurpose: The grain swells, the tube draws down the style toward signal dots, two sperm dots form and travel inside it, and they spill out beside the egg
scenes.onScreenChange: Water droplets enter the grain and it swells; the tube draws down the style over about 8 seconds with the camera following the tip; faint signal dots drift from the ovule and the tip bends toward them; the plain cell enters the tube and splits into two sperm dots that travel along it; the tube enters the ovule opening and the sperm spill out beside the egg with a scribble circle; the "pollen tube" label draws on
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the sperm beside the egg

scenes.visualReference: Ovule close-up with coded sperm dots, zygote circle, doubling cells and the sequence strip
scenes.teachingReason: Shows fertilisation as one sperm joining the egg and the zygote growing into an embryo
scenes.narrationCue: fertilisation / zygote / divides again and again / embryo
scenes.motionPurpose: One sperm dot merges with the egg into a zygote circle, then it doubles to a tiny embryo while the land, tube, join strip builds at the bottom
scenes.onScreenChange: One sperm dot moves into the egg and merges into a circle labelled "zygote"; the "one set + one set = two sets" chip appears; the circle splits to two, four and a cluster that grows into the embryo outline; "embryo" draws on; the strip icons for land, tube and join land on their cue words
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the embryo and the strip

scenes.visualReference: Aligned ovary and pod plates, then the bean seed cut-away with three leader lines
scenes.teachingReason: Shows the ovule becoming a seed and the ovary becoming a fruit, and what a seed holds
scenes.motionPurpose: The ovary crossfades into an open pod with seeds, then the bean seed cut-away gains three leader lines
scenes.onScreenChange: The ovary with three ovules crossfades to the pod with three seeds on "becomes a seed" and "grows into a fruit"; "pea pod", "fruit" and "seeds inside" draw on with leader lines; the bean seed appears with leader lines for embryo, food store (cotyledons) and seed coat; "seed" is added to the strip

scenes.visualReference: Bean seed anchor, carrier icons in a second colour, condition chips and the bean seedling plate
scenes.teachingReason: Separates seed dispersal from pollination and explains what a seed waits for before growing
scenes.narrationCue: carry seeds away / seed dispersal / water, oxygen and a suitable temperature / germinates
scenes.motionPurpose: Carrier icons return tagged carries seeds, three condition chips draw on, and the seedling fades in over the seed with roots down and leaves up
scenes.onScreenChange: The bean seed shrinks to the side; wind, water and animal icons return in blue-green with "carries seeds" and "seed dispersal" writes on with a tick and cross against the amber pollination tags; water drop, oxygen bubbles and thermometer chips draw on; the seedling fades in on "germinates" with roots drawing down and leaves lifting

scenes.visualReference: Strawberry runner recall, then onion bulb, potato tuber and mint cutting plates in turn
scenes.teachingReason: Names vegetative propagation as the asexual plant route with concrete examples
scenes.narrationCue: vegetative propagation / onion bulb / potato tuber / cutting / clone
scenes.motionPurpose: The runner stem draws on, three plates appear one at a time with the new part circled, then the plate duplicates into a clone pair
scenes.onScreenChange: The runner stem draws on as a recall; push-through to the onion, potato and mint plates one at a time with a scribble circle on the new bulb, sprouting eye and new roots; a "piece of parent, roots and leaves, new plant" strip runs under each; sperm and egg dots cross out; the plate duplicates on "clone"; a bee icon and wind line cross out

scenes.visualReference: Split board with the B1 clone row with disease and varied seedlings plates
scenes.teachingReason: Matches each route to conditions, retrieving B1 reasoning about clones and variety
scenes.narrationCue: steady paddock / new disease / reach new places
scenes.motionPurpose: The board splits into a healthy paddock of runners and a diseased clone row, then varied seedlings show a few survivors and a seed arcs over a fence
scenes.onScreenChange: A split board writes on; the paddock side shows runners spreading with a tick; the disease side shows every clone plant spotted, then the varied seedlings with survivors circled; a seed icon arcs over a fence on "reach new places"; "alike and close" and "varied and far" tags land

scenes.visualReference: Question card and four answer cards with sequence icons and marking brackets
scenes.teachingReason: Models how to build an outline answer one ordered sentence at a time
scenes.motionPurpose: The question card writes on, then four answer cards land on their sequence words with brackets, earlier cards shrinking to the rail
scenes.onScreenChange: The question writes on and "outline" is underlined with the margin note; the four cards land on "First", "Then", "Next" and "Finally" with sequence words underlined and key terms highlighted; each carries its strip icon; brackets for the three marking groups appear as each card lands; earlier cards shrink to the top rail
scenes.holdPurpose: Hold the four cards to read

scenes.visualReference: Three numbered vignettes: bagged flower, paintbrush on a stigma with part-way tubes, potato field beside seedling row
scenes.teachingReason: Unseen transfer with every condition visible, including that the bagged flowers cannot self-pollinate
scenes.motionPurpose: Countdown ring runs through the answer-free thinking hold
scenes.onScreenChange: The three numbered vignettes appear as each situation is named; the conditions stay on the board; the countdown ring starts after the narration
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet answer-free thinking hold with countdown

scenes.visualReference: Same three vignettes with verdict stamps, sequence strip states and clone and seedling rows
scenes.teachingReason: Explains each answer and names the knock-on, arrival-versus-joining and clones-worse slips
scenes.motionPurpose: Each vignette gets a verdict stamp and one-line card, with the strip showing which icons never start, which are lit, and the diseased clone row beside survivors
scenes.onScreenChange: Vignette one crosses out "land" with the bag and greys the later icons, then a knock-on arrow from "join" appears; vignette two lights "land" and "tube" with the tip short of the ovule and the verdict "not yet"; vignette three shows the spotted clone row beside circled survivors; amber doodles mark each trap

scenes.visualReference: Land, tube, join, seed strip written large with the stamen tag and next-lesson chip
scenes.teachingReason: Gives a reusable sequence aid and hands off to single-celled organisms
scenes.narrationCue: Pollination / Fertilisation / land, tube, join, seed / Next
scenes.motionPurpose: The four icons write on in a row with arrival and joining labels, the stamen tag returns, then the next chip with three cell icons appears
scenes.onScreenChange: The strip writes on large with "arrival" under land and "joining" under join; the STAMEN has MEN tag returns beside the stamen; the next-lesson chip appears with a budding yeast, a splitting bacterium and a protist outline

scenes.visualReference: Key notes card with the memory aid in large writing
scenes.motionPurpose: Notes appear then stay still for copying
scenes.onScreenChange: Five notes and the aid appear and lock
scenes.holdPurpose: Quiet copy hold with pause invitation
